title: Allen Doesn't See 'Imminent Return To Negotiations' With Iran
description:
Michael Allen, former special assistant to President George W. Bush in the National Security sector, says the US is taking its economic pressure campaign against Iran “right to the jugular,” describing Kharg Island as the “Achilles’ heel of the Iranian oil system.” Allen says he doesn't see an “imminent return to negotiations” and argues the US needs a more comprehensive strategy for dealing with China, Russia, Iran and North Korea. He speaks with Tyler Kendall on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."
